subject: Pilot safety-net: shortstop top-up request while invoice routes
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medpulse.io>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medpulse.io
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — pilot continuation while invoice routes

Hi David,

Quick heads up from procurement: our PO is drafted but hit a routing snag with an external approver in legal. Finance expects the signed PO to land in ~10 business days. The pilot environment is on a 14-day timer and we likely can't finish evaluation before it expires.

Could Redwood provide a short runway (7–14 days) to keep the sandbox live while the PO moves through approvals? We don't want to lose momentum on the integration work — folks on our side are blocked on a few acceptance tests.

I've attached the draft PO for reference. If a temporary token/credit grant helps, happy to confirm details from our end.

Thanks for any flexibility,
Jordan
Jordan Price
Head of Integrations, MedPulse
(jordan.price@medpulse.io)

Attachment: PO_Draft_MedPulse.pdf (pdf, 324 KB)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medpulse.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot continuation while invoice routes

Hi Jordan — thanks for the note and for sharing the PO draft. Sorry to hear about the routing loop. We can absolutely help preserve the pilot while the PO completes.

Proposed shortstop: we can provision a 10-day sandbox top-up (equivalent of your current daily usage) today to keep everything running. If you need the full 14 days, I'll escalate to finance for sign-off — that generally takes 24–48 hours.

Can you confirm:
- Expected date the signed PO will be back to you?
- Is there a preferred billing contact we should sync with to speed approval once the invoice is created?

If you confirm the 10-day window now, we'll trigger the top-up immediately and send a follow-up note with the temporary credit ID.

Best,
David
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
( david_kim@redwood.com )

---
Note: CCing Camila (solutions) for any technical pick-up and Naomi (finance ops) to prepare a temporary-credit approval if we decide to extend to 14 days.

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medpulse.io>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: MedPulse Procurement <procurement@medpulse.io>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot continuation while invoice routes

Thanks David — good plan. Our procurement lead says the earliest fully executed PO date is likely 2027-07-06 (10 business days from today). Given that, could we please request a 14-day top-up to be safe? If that's a non-starter, the 10-day will probably be fine but I'd rather avoid an interruption.

Billing contact is: Ellen Park, Senior Accountant <ellen.park@medpulse.io>. She'll be the signer once legal clears the PO.

If helpful, I'm re-attaching the draft PO in case the routing notes are useful.

Appreciate the quick support,
Jordan

Attachment: PO_Draft_MedPulse.pdf (pdf, 324 KB)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medpulse.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@medpulse.io>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot continuation while invoice routes

Jordan — thanks for the quick confirmation and for the billing contact.

Update: Naomi has provisionally approved a 10-day top-up from our temporary runway pool and we've generated a temporary credit token: TEMP-CREDIT-MP-20270622-10D. That will be applied to your sandbox immediately (you should see usage resume in ~10 minutes).

I've started the finance escalation for the additional 4 days (to hit 14 total) — Naomi, Camila, any blockers on approving the extra 4 days to fully cover until 2027-07-06? If finance needs additional sign-off from MedPulse, please let us know and we'll hold the extra grant until we receive explicit approval.

Jordan — if that's acceptable, we'll consider the 10-day active and follow-up with a formal note and the temporary-credit stub. Also dropping a short summary into HubSpot for record-keeping: https://app.hubspot.com/records/MP-2027-0421

Best,
David
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
